comment: Mutants for the W9 port (internal/domain/otp and internal/domain/authsteps).
Each entry names one source file, one exact string to find, and what to put
in its place. run.sh applies the replacement to a copy, hands the copy to
`go build -overlay` and `go test -overlay`, and never touches the tracked
file. `find` must occur exactly `count` times (default 1), so a mutant that
no longer lands on code fails loudly instead of quietly doing nothing.
`observable` says which compared value the changed expression reaches; a
mutant that cannot change any compared output is equivalent and proves

mutants.name: otp-window-edge-inclusive
mutants.observable: a row exactly at window_start joins in_window, so `allowed` and `reason` change

mutants.name: otp-cooldown-boundary-inclusive
mutants.observable: a row exactly at the cooldown answers resend_too_soon instead of ok

mutants.name: otp-window-count-strict
mutants.observable: the fifth challenge in the window is allowed, so `allowed` changes

mutants.name: otp-retry-after-truncates
mutants.observable: retry_after_seconds loses the ceiling and reports one second less

mutants.name: otp-total-seconds-rounds-twice
mutants.observable: a gap of more than about 285 years rounds the microsecond count to a double before dividing, which moves retry_after_seconds

mutants.name: otp-timedelta-skips-c-int
mutants.observable: a window past a C int raises the other OverflowError message

mutants.name: otp-expiry-boundary-strict
mutants.observable: a challenge exactly at its deadline is live instead of expired

mutants.name: otp-burned-already-strict
mutants.observable: a challenge at exactly max_attempts takes one more guess

mutants.name: otp-burn-strict
mutants.observable: the fifth wrong guess answers wrong_code with zero left instead of burned

mutants.name: otp-consumed-after-expired
mutants.observable: a spent AND expired challenge names the other outcome

mutants.name: otp-pad-ignores-sign
mutants.find: if pad := width - len(sign) - len(digits); pad > 0 {
mutants.observable: a negative draw is padded one digit too wide

mutants.name: steps-invite-expiry-boundary
mutants.observable: an invitation exactly at its deadline still mints a session

mutants.name: steps-digest-length-ignored
mutants.observable: a stored digest of another length compares by its prefix, so a challenge of another number can be reached

mutants.name: steps-phone-digest-not-checked
mutants.observable: a challenge issued to another number is verified against this caller's code

mutants.name: steps-attempt-not-recorded-before-refusal
mutants.observable: a wrong guess makes no record_otp_attempt call, so the recorded call list changes

mutants.name: steps-burned-not-consumed
mutants.observable: record_otp_attempt is called with consumed false on the last wrong guess

mutants.name: steps-code-not-stripped-before-emptiness
mutants.observable: a code of only whitespace reaches the digest instead of answering code_required

mutants.name: steps-python-only-whitespace
mutants.observable: a code wrapped in U+001C..U+001F keeps them, so its digest differs

mutants.name: steps-binding-ignored
mutants.observable: a bound number derives an id again instead of reading account_identities

mutants.name: steps-deleted-person-revived
mutants.observable: an ended account is signed back into instead of becoming a new person

mutants.name: steps-stored-challenge-id-ignored
mutants.observable: the answer names the drawn id rather than the stored one

mutants.name: steps-session-owner-not-checked
mutants.observable: somebody else's session is revoked instead of answering 404

mutants.name: steps-token-digest-before-permission
mutants.observable: a refused caller still hashes the bearer, so the recorded call list grows one entry

mutants.name: steps-link-invitation-accepted
mutants.observable: a link invitation reaches the repository with no person, changing the call list

mutants.name: steps-google-blank-name-kept
mutants.observable: a blank Google name becomes the person's name instead of the placeholder

mutants.name: steps-google-race-not-reread
mutants.observable: the racing login re-raises instead of signing in as the winner

mutants.name: steps-session-echoes-argument
mutants.observable: the answer names the door from the argument rather than the stored row

mutants.name: steps-missing-person-refuses
mutants.observable: a person row that cannot be read back answers with an empty name
